messages:
leo: Heads up—edge sample CI started failing after the ESM refactor. tsc in our edge build throws duplicate types + a generic inference error.

sam: can you paste the CI output and the tsconfig used for the edge target?

leo: CI snippet:
ci-bot:
```
> tsc -p tsconfig.edge.json
src/runtime/index.ts:92:18 - error TS2345: Argument of type 'T' is not assignable to parameter of type 'unknown'.
92   return runtime.call<T>(path, body)
                   ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
src/types/runtime.d.ts:5:5 - error TS2300: Duplicate identifier 'RuntimeOptions'.
5 export interface RuntimeOptions { timeout?: number }
```

leo: tsconfig.edge.json sets "moduleResolution":"bundler", "lib":["DOM","ES2021"], "types":["node"], declaration: true (legacy config). We use esbuild to bundle for edge.

ivy: two problems: node typings + declaration emit colliding with our browser types, and overload/generic ordering causing T to be treated as any/unknown. Remove node types for edge and disable declaration for that pipeline.

dom: also check package.exports. If the consumer pulls the CJS runtime entry when bundling, node-only types leak into the bundle. Make sure browser/edge have a clear export path (e.g., "./runtime": {"import":"./dist/esm/runtime.js","require":"./dist/cjs/runtime.js","browser":"./dist/browser/runtime.js"}).

sam: quick fixes to try:
- tsconfig.edge.json: "types": [], "declaration": false, "skipLibCheck": true
- reorder overloads so the generic signature is last, or add a thin generic wrapper: export const callTyped = <T>(p: string, x: T) => runtime.call<T>(p, x)
- ensure bundler resolves the browser field or explicit browser entrypoint

leo: example overload that tripped us:
```
export function call<T>(path: string, body: T): Promise<Resp<T>>
export function call(path: string, body: unknown): Promise<Resp<unknown>>
export function call(path: string, body: any) { /* impl */ }
```
At call site client.call('x', {a:1}) became any rather than {a:number}.

ivy: TS picks the first matching overload for inference; move generic overload after concrete ones or force explicit generic on call. We should document this pattern in SDK DX doc.

leo: I swapped tsconfig.edge.json to: {"compilerOptions": {"lib":["DOM","ES2021"], "types": [], "moduleResolution":"bundler", "skipLibCheck":true, "declaration":false}} and CI passed locally.

dom: I'll update package.json exports to include a browser field and add a test that verifies the edge bundle doesn't pull node types.

sam: also add an example in examples/edge-quickstart with a minimal tsconfig + vite/esbuild config and a small wrapper util callTyped. That should reduce onboarding friction.

leo: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/421 with the tsconfig change, exports tweak, and example. CI passing on branch.

ivy: follow-up note for docs: recommend public API use unknown and provide typed helper for inference, and include a short note on overload ordering + explicit generics.

leo: thanks. closing once PR merges.
